journey.name: Full Player Controls
journey.description: Verifies expanding the full player screen from the mini-player and testing play, pause, skip, and replay controls.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the "Play" button on the first episode to start playback.
Tap on the mini-player bar at the bottom of the screen to expand the full player screen.
Verify that the full player screen is displayed with the episode title, podcast title, playback progress slider, and playback controls.
Tap the "Pause" button in the center of the player screen.
Verify that playback is paused and the center button changes to "Play".
Tap the "Play" button in the center of the player screen.
Verify that playback resumes and the center button changes to "Pause".
